title: Carry frames through 534 native field swaps with exact dual replay (no new κ)
body:
This adds a source-bound construction replacing 534 three-ADD weighted swaps per orientation with direct weighted field exchanges that carry their frame labels. Of these, 43 enter with unequal frames. The constructive algebraic proof and portable checker preserve all 632 independent-input rows, all 408 helpers, terminal frames and owned-cell cleanup in both orientations.

The recursive profile is unchanged: `{1:2201, 2:412, 3:510, 4:127, 5:40, 8:8}`. **No higher κ or physical tape speedup is claimed.** The useful output is a concrete alternate word representation that removes forced common-frame contacts at these swaps, ready for joint frame/schedule optimization. The signed-swap identity itself is classical.

Validation: registered Python 3.12 standard-library replay, normal and optimized; exact all-input endpoint comparison; sign and missing-frame-carry mutations; frozen-commit byte comparison and Git-free package replay. Shared retained row primitives are disclosed. Native physical-map correctness remains inherited; complete tape costs, multiplier/outer replay, Lean verification and hosted CI are not supplied. Source history is shallow; full-history ancestry auditing is not claimed. Retained source bytes are committed on this branch, so no pending PR fetch is needed for replay.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/native-frame-carrying-swaps
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/native-frame-carrying-swaps
```

Credit Cao Yifan’s round-three source beyond #4610; Cinna Davis’s scalar/helper and #4440/#4470 lineage; Dugongue’s transported-frame and #4935/#4948 source binding; zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and all retained NOTICE authors. This exchanges entire owner fields, unlike the coordinate-SWAP model discussed in #4950. Targeted previous overlap checks reached #4955; Discussion coverage remains incomplete and no exhaustive novelty claim is made.

Only `research/native-frame-carrying-swaps/` changes. Canonical main was refreshed to b91956876e5b4122fd89179f1b57557ff8378f15; relevant guidance, priorities and selected record were unchanged. Prepared by Dugongue with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, one agent, no subagents. The selected frontier is unchanged. Open next questions and concrete first steps are in README.md and TASK.json.
